exposure: combination of in situ and intramuscular injections
outcome: Primary success rate of methotrexate treatment (negative β-human chorionic gonadotropin level without additional treatment)
finding: The use of in situ injection of methotrexate, either solely or in conjunction with intramuscular injection, was significantly correlated with a higher primary success rate for nontubular ectopic pregnancy treatment compared to solely intramuscular injection.
